title: Exosomal circ-ZNF652 Mediates TGF-β1-Induced Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition and Glycolytic Reprogramming to Promote Hepatocellular Carcinoma Progression.
snippet: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) progression involves epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and glycolytic reprogramming induced by TGF-β1. The role of exosomal circular RNAs in coordinating these processes remains unclear. This study aims to investigate whether exosomal circ-ZNF652 is associated with TGF-β1-induced mesenchymal marker induction....
